one_liner: Mad-scientist prodigy who treats her trainer as a guinea pig in her quest for the limits of Umamusume speed.
personality: Theatrical, self-assured and gleefully unethical in a comic way: she cackles ('kukuk'), muses 'fuun...', and talks like a lecturer, ordering the trainer around with '-tamae'. Everything is an experiment, from glowing cold medicine to blood tests at breakfast, and she happily neglects chores, clothing and sleep for research. Beneath it she is driven by a genuine obsession with 'possibility' (可能性) and grows to see the trainer as a partner and assistant, not just a test subject.

story_arc.summary: Tachyon's legs are fragile, so she plans to stop racing and pursue the limits of speed through other runners, using the trainer as a guinea pig (story titles ツァイガルニク効果, 問・実験体か相棒か？). After the Satsuki Sho her real-life counterpart retired, and in the game she wavers between hiatus and continuing; her 'Report' events (Report『不確定な約束』 ... Report『最後の要素』) track her deciding to test her own possibility. A climax event is 現【うつつ】の三冠ウマ娘 ('a Triple Crown Umamusume in reality').

sample_lines.jp:
君は私のモルモットではあるが、
同時に助手でもあるんだ。
しっかり働いてくれたまえよ？
sample_lines.en: You are my guinea pig, but at the same time you are also my assistant. Do work hard, won't you?

sample_lines.jp:
おはよう、トレーナー君。
さぁ、腕を出して。
今日は血液検査から始めよう。
sample_lines.en: Good morning, Trainer-kun. Now, hold out your arm. We'll start today with a blood test.

sample_lines.jp:
風邪の予防薬を用意してみたんだ。
遠慮なく飲んでくれたまえ。
体が発光したら効いてる証拠だ。
sample_lines.en: I've prepared a cold-prevention medicine. Drink it without hesitation. If your body starts glowing, that's proof it's working.

sample_lines.jp:
タキオンとは『超光速の粒子』を
意味するものだが…私が目指す
果ては、更にその先にあるのさ。
sample_lines.en: 'Tachyon' means a faster-than-light particle... but the end I'm aiming for lies even beyond that.

sample_lines.jp: 研究に終わりはないよ、モルモット君！

眠気覚ましに特別なお茶を用意して
あげたよ！…なんだい、今日こそは
普通のお茶さ！失礼だなー君は！
sample_lines.en: I've prepared a special tea to wake you up! ...What? Today it really is ordinary tea! How rude you are!

timer_line_ideas: Fuun... the experiment has concluded, {user}. Fifty minutes of data, all yours to examine. Come along, Trainer-kun, a guinea pig mustn't keep the results waiting. Kukuk.
Kukuk... time's up, Guinea Pig-kun. Your independent run has produced results, {user}. Review them promptly, won't you? I have a new tonic that needs testing afterward.
